recipes.name: Popeyes Blackened Ranch Sauce
ingredients: ½ cup (120g) crème fraîche, or sour cream
2 Tbsp (6g) fresh chives, very thinly sliced
¼ cup (10g) fresh parsley, finely chopped
Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper, to taste
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the mayonnaise, crème fraîche, Dijon, buttermilk, chives, parsley, dill, paprika, onion powder, cayenne, celery powder, grated garlic, salt and pepper to taste, and MSG. Whisk until thoroughly combined and smooth.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving to allow the herbs and spices to bloom. For the best flavor, refrigerate overnight.
